EFW_KaelenHub.name: Lower Kaelen-Sector Mag-Lev Hub
EFW_KaelenHub.text: A working transit hub beneath the Nuxis Array: wet decking, freight, commuters long since cleared by municipal enforcement. Keep present-day infrastructure legible and ordinary enough for remembered war geography to feel invasive.

EFW_NuxisArchives.name: Nuxis Array Archives
EFW_NuxisArchives.text: A sealed rotating archive holding records deliberately excluded from public history. Monumental scale is useful, but the drama is who is allowed to remember and what Adrian is willing to do to gain access.

EFW_VentAlpha.name: Ventilation Conduit Alpha
EFW_VentAlpha.text: A cramped maintenance route through the transit structure. Theo's escape depends increasingly on routes Rae remembers rather than routes a current map can explain.

EFW_Relay04.name: Deep-Range Relay Station 04
EFW_Relay04.text: A remote communications station where Rae and Kyn try to keep contact with Theo while evacuation spreads. Treat failing equipment as pressure on the people, not as the subject of the scene.

EFW_CargoBay.name: Cargo Bay Doors
EFW_CargoBay.text: A freight staging bay with a single obvious exit, where Theo first discovers that remembered command presence can move through him strongly enough for another person to see it.

EFW_ProcessingCore.name: Central Processing Core
EFW_ProcessingCore.text: The protected heart of the Nuxis archival complex. Present-day access controls can remain mundane; Adrian's moral compromise, not their engineering, is the scene.

EFW_SubspaceArray.name: Subspace Comm Array
EFW_SubspaceArray.text: An exposed relay pit where present transmissions become contaminated by voices and orders from the erased war.

EFW_AbandonedCarriage.name: Abandoned Mag-Lev Carriage
EFW_AbandonedCarriage.text: A dead transit car where Theo is alone with the shard and the remembered presence of General Mero. The carriage can become a war room only through reality/memory overlap, never a technical projection.

EFW_CommandNexus.name: Array Command Nexus
EFW_CommandNexus.text: A sealed archive-control chamber where Adrian finally breaks his neutrality and physically forces a choice from Tallis.

EFW_TransitJunction.name: Main Transit Junction
EFW_TransitJunction.text: A large public concourse emptied by pursuit. In the climax, the station briefly remembers an older catastrophe and the present goes dark with it.

EFW_UpperHatch.name: Upper Sector Maintenance Hatch
EFW_UpperHatch.text: A maintenance exit opening onto a rain-soaked plaza. The episode ends by privileging direct human description of the present over inherited tactical certainty.
